item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Oldsmar mother celebrates PCOS name change, doctors explain what it means for women
item.description: An Oldsmar mother who sought fertility treatments is highlighting a common hormonal disorder after discovering she had the condition long known as polycystic ovarian syndrome, or PCOS.
